role: Reviewer and research collaborator on substantive revision of Paper 1
authorization: Initial wording forbade experiments; user then explicitly said 可以做实验.
User additionally authorized long theoretical derivation, verification and experiments.
Prior continuing authorization covers archiving dialogue, suggestions, code and results to center-666/paperlast.
scope: Audit ACMW formulas; reproduce provided code in isolated directory; test adverse geometry; connect to unchanged original common-G on frozen supplementary models.
not_a_claim: No replacement of original manuscript or 50-node model, no proof of universal KL/power/secure-state advantage, no novelty clearance.

experiments.source_reproduction: Run exact supplied ACMW 700-case code without modification, in an isolated results directory; compare with supplied JSON.
experiments.information: Compute angular MI with beta-weighted Gauss-Jacobi rules of orders 64/128/256 and compare with original plain Legendre order 600.
experiments.analytical_geometry: H=I2, A=1.04 I2 or 1.04 J, L=2, process and measurement covariances I2, coded energy 10, kappa 2, rho .7; identical settings except dynamics. Exact opposite covariance signs are proved analytically.
experiments.moment_and_power_validation: 20 batches of 5000 watermark trajectories per condition, IID and ACMW, lengths 2, m=2, paired nominal Gaussian noises; verify covariances and single-window nominal chi-square .05 false alarm; report power as sample fraction with batch SE.
experiments.state_bridge: Frozen unstable/stable supplementary five-node common-G and separately registered regional model; 32 output times, prior B1-registered A0 replay (onset 7/duration10/coded energy10, ordinary direction (-1.89,.42)); exact moments, then 20x5000 paired physical-noise paths per model as diagnostic cross-check; no gating, new compensation, or state truth access in decisions.
experiments.design_diagnostic: For supplementary models, kappa grid 0,.5,1,2,4 with rho .7; report single internal-window covariance KL surrogate and whole-horizon original common-G contamination MSE. Include IID and do not infer optimum from grid.
experiments.same_zeta_information: Compare mixed rho=.7 kappa2 with pure tilt rho1, kappa root matching c1; verify same covariance metrics and lower MI analytically and numerically.

frozen: Existing models, attacks, seeds, gains, healthy detector calibration and old results remain unchanged.
No main manuscript rewrite or branch merge.
No claimed BSCW risk validation under original ten-tap energy or globally optimal estimator; separate local diagnostic reruns are labeled below.

post_audit_scope_amendment.reason: Source review revealed first/third BSCW noise variances do not match the previously derived four-observation regional model, and diffuse-state projection is not joint finite-prior optimum.
post_audit_scope_amendment.source_BSCW_reproduction: Run provided BSCW 15x50000 code unchanged in an isolated copy to verify published rounded table values.
post_audit_scope_amendment.noise_sensitivity: Rerun provided BSCW 15x50000 code changing Sigma to diag(1,.5,1/1.04^2,.58/1.12^2), and update descriptive metadata; retain local parameter-norm energy and qualify this as sensitivity, not original ten-tap validation.
post_audit_scope_amendment.heldout_diagnostic: IID, BSCW-.35 and full LC-TCW; both contrast-ridge and joint-finite-prior-ridge families; 3 repeats, each 50000 calibration and 50000 separate evaluation watermark pairs, corrected Sigma, Px1, exact two-tap energy Gram I+A^TA, E10. Alpha and estimators fixed before this heldout run; no claim of optimality or original ten-tap equivalence.
